Every Ionic capital is decorated with sc.why: The defining feature of the order, stated in every architecture reference: 'Ionic capital' occurs 2,842 times in Dolma and 'Ionic' has 'volutes' nearby about 4,200 times; Wikipedia states it in the lead. No exceptions: four-sided and diagonal Ionic capitals still have volutes; a capital with acanthus leaves is Corinthian or Composite.

notes: TBox rule edit. Derivability very_unlikely: the volute is the definition of the order. Plausibility: acanthus leaves belong to the Corinthian capital, a common confusion; clearly false. Well-known members: the Erechtheion and the Jefferson Memorial; by-name storage of their capitals is weaker than for most members, so the rule worlds are likely the majority here (Decisions 4). The Erechtheion query says 'column capitals' to leave out the Porch of the Caryatids. Two independent storage choices give four worlds. In the by-name worlds the building keeps its volutes and its columns' membership in the Ionic order gives way (the order is defined by its capital); it is never an exception to the rule.
